sources.title: Visual comparisons | Playwright
sources.supports: Screenshot baseline generation on first run, subsequent comparisons, environment-related rendering variance, and reviewed updates.
sources.limitations: Vendor documentation describes tooling behavior; pixel diffs do not establish design quality or accessibility.

sources.title: Emulation | Playwright
sources.supports: Configurable device parameters, viewport, touch, locale, timezone, permissions, color scheme and device emulation.
sources.limitations: Emulation is not full physical-device validation.

sources.title: Projects | Playwright
sources.supports: Project matrix across browsers/devices/configurations and configurable execution ordering/parallelism.
sources.limitations: Broad matrix can increase local resource use; recommendation to limit concurrency is based on supplied machine constraint.

sources.title: Accessibility testing | Playwright
sources.supports: axe integration, state-specific scans, examples, and explicit limitation that automated checks do not detect all accessibility problems.
sources.limitations: Automated scans need manual assessment as documented by Playwright.

sources.title: Page API | Playwright
sources.supports: Screenshot controls for animation, caret, fullPage, masks, styles, scale and related capture behavior.
sources.limitations: Configuration stabilizes capture mechanics but cannot ensure semantic equivalence or quality.

sources.title: Interaction tests | Storybook
sources.supports: Stories as initial component state plus simulated actions/assertions; Vitest addon execution paths.
sources.limitations: Component-state tests complement, rather than replace, full-screen review.

sources.title: Accessibility tests | Storybook
sources.supports: axe-based accessibility addon and integrating tests into component tests/CI.
sources.limitations: Storybook documentation describes automated heuristics; manual accessibility testing remains necessary.

sources.limitations: Check current exact package and transitive dependency notices when installing.

sources.title: microsoft/playwright LICENSE

sources.limitations: Check package-specific and bundled browser/dependency notices before distribution.

sources.title: dequelabs/axe-core GitHub repository
sources.supports: Repository identifies axe-core as Mozilla Public License 2.0 and notes bundled dependencies have their own terms.
sources.limitations: Exact dependency bundle/license obligations need project-specific review.

sources.title: Accessibility – Radix Primitives
sources.supports: Radix documents ARIA/role, focus management and keyboard support, with application-provided labels/context still required.
sources.limitations: Library documentation cannot guarantee an individual application integration is accessible.

sources.title: radix-ui/primitives GitHub repository
sources.supports: Official source repository identifies MIT license.
sources.limitations: Confirm exact package/version and transitive dependency notices.

sources.title: Introduction – shadcn/ui
sources.supports: Project describes distributing editable component source code rather than only importing a closed component package.
sources.limitations: The project’s visual defaults are not the authority for this app’s selected design direction.

sources.title: shadcn-ui/ui LICENSE.md
sources.supports: Official source repository license text identifies MIT.
sources.limitations: Open-source code license does not determine the license of separately selected assets or all generated components.

sources.title: Motion | Apple Human Interface Guidelines
sources.supports: Apple recommends purposeful, optional, brief motion and alternative feedback, with user ability to cancel where possible.
sources.limitations: Apple HIG targets Apple platforms; application to web is a design-principle inference, not web conformance guidance.

sources.title: Materials | Apple Human Interface Guidelines
sources.supports: Apple advises selecting materials/effects by semantic use and ensuring legibility.
sources.limitations: Apple-specific material APIs and platform effects do not transfer literally to browser UI.

sources.title: Typography | Apple Human Interface Guidelines
sources.supports: Apple HIG typography guidance as a source for readable type hierarchy.
sources.limitations: Platform source; chosen web fonts and actual rendering need local validation. Search result opened but rendered no extractable page body.

sources.title: Color | Apple Human Interface Guidelines
sources.supports: Consistent semantic use of colors and adapting for accessibility/appearance contexts.
sources.limitations: Apple platform guidance is not directly a web standard.

sources.title: WCAG 2.2 Quick Reference – Keyboard
sources.supports: WCAG SC 2.1.1: all functionality is operable from a keyboard interface, with its defined exception.
sources.limitations: Conformance is broader than the single keyboard criterion; assess the full applicable standard.

sources.title: Understanding SC 1.4.10: Reflow | W3C WAI
sources.supports: 320 CSS-pixel vertical reflow condition and exception for content needing two-dimensional layout.
sources.limitations: The cited page explains WCAG 2.1; verify project’s required target conformance edition and all other applicable success criteria.

sources.title: Getting started - CLI | Playwright
sources.supports: Official Playwright CLI documentation recommends CLI skills as token-efficient compared with browser automation MCPs for coding-agent tasks.
sources.limitations: Recommendation concerns agent tooling/token use; it does not establish performance or cost for this project. Parent supplied the local-app and authenticated-browser boundaries.
